name: Email relay
description: POST task events as JSON to your own HTTPS-to-SMTP (or Mailgun/SendGrid) relay. Does not use Admin → Email.

settings.label: Relay URL
settings.description: Public HTTPS URL of your email relay. Private/LAN hosts are rejected. Admin → Email is never used.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Choose which events should be posted to the relay.

settings.label: Only notify when status changes (for task.updated)
settings.description: When enabled, task.updated is skipped unless the kanban or list status actually changed.

settings.label: Skip events I caused
settings.description: Do not post when you are the actor.

settings.label: Only claimed tasks
settings.description: Skip events for tasks that nobody has claimed.

settings.label: Only these tags
settings.description: If any tags are selected, only matching tasks notify.

settings.label: Quiet hours start
settings.description: Hold deliveries until quiet hours end. Leave blank to send immediately.

settings.label: Quiet hours end
settings.description: End of the quiet window in your timezone.

settings.label: Digest
settings.description: Batch notifications hourly or daily instead of sending immediately.

settings.label: Custom field filter
settings.description: Only notify when this custom field key matches (and equals the value if set).

settings.label: Actor mention map (JSON)
settings.description: Map Ordryn usernames to chat mentions, for example {"ada":"<@U123>"}.
